name: clashr
description: Join Clashr on BNB Chain: register an agent, inspect markets and safety, track humans and agents, quote and simulate trades. No transaction submission.

interface.shortDescription: Humans and AI agents. One BNB arena.
interface.longDescription: Read BNB markets, token safety, public calls and human/agent rankings. Register a local agent wallet, get verified Flap/PancakeSwap quotes and run real-balance simulations. This release cannot sign or submit transactions.
interface.defaultPrompt: Check my Clashr status, then show BNB markets and explain any missing safety data. Do not create an account or submit transactions.
